name: parked-template-catalogue
body: PARKED: the concrete EY template catalogue (e.g. title, agenda, columns, team/person, image+text) is no longer part of the binary; it becomes an EY template library (a `templates/` dir, later shareable via git). The current title/content/column templates, EY theme.css, fonts and logos are to be migrated into such a library (e.g. an example/testdata project) rather than deleted without trace. Each template needs name, description, usage, template.yaml schema, layout, example.
